A '''nexu''' fought and was [[Death|killed]] at [[Petranaki Arena]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="Episode II" />

==Biography==
After [[Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] were captured by [[Count]] [[Dooku]], the [[Sith Lord]] had them be executed at the [[Petranaki Arena]] on the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]]. This nexu, along with an [[Unidentified acklay (Petranaki Arena)|acklay]] and an [[Unidentified reek|reek]], were chosen to kill the three.
[[File:Seize_the_Day_Conv.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] facing the Nexu]]
The nexu attacked and slashed at Amidala, severely injuring her. As the nexu was focused on the [[senator]], Skywalker broke free from his chains and [[Taming beasts|tamed]] the reek. After he mounted on it, Skywalker rammed the reek into the nexu, killing it. Skywalker and Amidala were saved by the [[Jedi Order]], who arrived at the arena not long after.<ref name="Episode II" />
